Markus '''"myz"''' Sipola is a Finnish Quakeworld player, coming from the darkest forests of [https://goo.gl/maps/xDMjyVjhVMcPo7b88 Lapland]. Propably most known for his movement skills in [[1on1]] and [[2on2]], he was never much of a [[4on4]] player, although he says he's looking forward to it.

He found Quake in [[1998]] while visiting a friends place and saw his dad, {{Player|Shotqun|flag=fi}} of clan [[PMC]], playing the game. The friends tirelessly waited for the father to fall asleep at night to be able to play it themselves. Later on, in [[2000]], he got himself stable internet connection and the journey could begin for real.
